rows: an `Int` division, floor-division or modulo has a zero divisor. A `Float` division by zero does not trap ([LDET.3.6.2])

the operation is undefined at that input and is not an IEEE `Float` operation — a negative shift count, `now()` read while the wall clock has no value ([LTIM.2.8.3]), `local()` or `date()` with no `TimeZoneOffset` fact in force ([LTIM.10.5.3]), an interval whose endpoints are not `start <= end` ([LINT.7.2])

an operation has no representable result **and wrapping would destroy its meaning** — a **total** conversion (`Float :: Int` on a value non-finite, or finite and outside `Int`); a `Json` value a rule builds past a limit (LGRA.5.8.6); an operation on `Time` or `Date` operands whose result leaves its type's range ([LTIM.1.1.5], [LTIM.1.2.2], [LTIM.4.1.1], [LTIM.4.2.3]); a `Duration` scaled by a `Float` whose result is non-finite or outside `Int` ([LTIM.4.1.1])
